profile.headline: Junior Full-Stack Software Developer | React, JavaScript, C#/.NET
profile.summary:
CERTIFICATIONS & PUBLICATIONS

Licensed Member of the West Virginia State Bar, (October, 2007 - Present)  

Certified Mediator, Juvenile and Domestic Relation District Court, Portsmouth, VA (2002-2003)

Book Review, “Are you an Informed Consumer of the Legal Information Market Place” for the Virginia Lawyer in 1998

Specialties: academic,  accountancy,  adr,  approach,  books,  budgeting,  business law,  cd - rom,  competitive,  customer relations,  database administration,  financial,  legal,  legal research,  llm,  marketing,  materials management,  microsoft office,  microsoft word,  negotiation,  publicity,  real estate,  research,  sales,  seminars,  westlaw,

positions.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Intensive full-time 6-month software development immersive training program focusing on full stack (C#/.NET) development fundamentals and problem solving. The final half of the program executed in a simulated company environment with Scrum methodology.
Applied object-oriented programming fundamentals through team-based projects that reflect real world business problems
Collaborated remotely on projects using Slack and Zoom
Managed source code version control with Git/ GitHub
Applied JavaScript, HTML, and CSS fundamentals to build a feature-rich social media dashboard
Leveraged native ES6 module bundling to build DRY, reusable components
Designed and built mediation scheduler with React using hooks
Designed applications through white boarding dependencies and building ERD’s
Built and interacted with databases using SQL and ADO.NET
Developed a blog management platform in ASP.NET, MVC, and Razor templates in Visual Studio 2022

positions.title: Solo Practitioner / Estate Planner, Mediator
positions.description:
Prepares wills, trusts, powers of attorney and other estate planning documents for clients in accordance with applicable law. 
Review existing estate plans to ensure that they are current and appropriate given the client’s circumstances.
 Assists clients in preparing for incapacity by identifying potential risks or problems so that steps can be taken to minimize or eliminate them.
Provides general advice regarding a variety of legal issues such as family law matters and contract issues. 
Acts as a mediator in civil and family conflict matters facilitating communication and conflict resolution between parties.
Prepares final mediation agreements and documentation when parties have come to an agreement about their dispute.

positions.title: Adjunct Criminal Law Instructor
positions.description:
Prepared lectures, assignments, and in-field experiences to collaborate with necessary course curriculum for criminal law and procedure.
Designed lectures and learning activities to suit different learning styles to help students achieve their academic goals 
Mentored struggling students one-on-one regarding course materials and other academic issues.
Prepared student for real world application of course knowledge to future employment settings. 
Evaluated student learning through exams and observation.

positions.title: CLE Associate
positions.description:
Assisted with the coordination of over 12 continuing legal education seminars per year.
Directed and oversaw all aspects of the seminar registration process
Assisted with the organization's daily accounting, the preparation of monthly financial reports, annual budget and audit.
Involved in the preparation of advertisement materials
Managed student staff

positions.title: District Manager/Security Consultant
positions.description:
Demonstrated ability to approach business in both creative and analytical ways to increase performance and clientele numbers
Managed and was responsible for the overall productivity of the Hampton district office which served the entire Tidewater region of Virginia
Directed, trained, and motivated sales team to reach maximum potential in a highly competitive market

positions.title: Mediator
positions.description:
Interviewed parties and drafted agreements
Successfully brought parties to mutually amicable solutions in divorce and custody situations through negotiation and presentation abilities

positions.title: Legal Instructor
positions.description:
Prepared course materials and taught a wide of law classes to people of varying academic
       levels. Courses taught included criminal law, family law, legal research, ADR, real estate law,
       and business law.

positions.title: Law Reference Librarian
positions.description:
Involved in planning and providing resource accessibility for one of the first online LLM
      programs. As member of the professional staff, assisted with the overall management of the
      law library. Provided research support for law faculty, law students, attorneys, and outside
      patrons. Instructed individuals on the use of a variety of software and databases including
      LexisNexis, Westlaw, CD-ROM resources, Premise Folios, the Internet, MS Word, and OPAC.
